verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a done-for-you compliance service that files state annual and initial reports in all 50 states, backed by deadline alerts, mail monitoring and a compliance concierge team. That lets a user hand off annual-report filing with little manual work, and a CPA Practice Advisor report independently confirms the annual report filing. However, the evidence shows only Gusto's own service and team doing the filing; nothing shows an AI agent driving or preparing it through the platform, so only the delegation outcome is evidenced. Missing for 10: any AI-agent, API or MCP path for initiating or preparing filings; evidence of how much human review the filing flow requires; hands-on confirmation of agent-driven delegation.
